agenda_items.section: CALL TO ORDER AND ROLL CALL
agenda_items.title: CALL TO ORDER AND ROLL CALL
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Mayor Osborne called the regular January 19, 2010 council meeting to order at 6:00p.m. in the council chambers.

agenda_items.title: PUBLIC PARTICIPATION and COUNCIL/STAFF RESPONSE
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council reached consensus that a staff report should return with options for a moratorium as soon as possible so that the matter is addressed prior to spring.

agenda_items.title: CONSENT AGENDA
agenda_items.outcome_summary: The motion carried 9:0 with item 3C amended and Council Members Ageton, Becker, Karakehian and Wilson opposed to item 3A.

agenda_items.title: FOURTH READING AND CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO ADOPT ORDINANCE NO. 7701 (ATTACHMENT A), REPEALING CHAPTER 9-13, INCLUSIONARY ZONING OF THE BOULDER REVISED CODE AND ADOPTING IN ITS PLACE CHAPTER 9-13, INCLUSIONARY HOUSING.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council approved item 3A, with Council Members Ageton, Becker, Karakehian and Wilson opposed.

agenda_items.title: INTRODUCTION, FIRST READING AND CONSIDERATION OF AN EMERGENCY ORDINANCE ADOPTING SUPPLEMENT NO. 103, WHICH CODIFIES PREVIOUSLY ADOPTED ORDINANCE NOS. 7672, 7684, 7687, 7690, 7697, 7698, 7699, AND 7706 AND OTHER MISCELLANEOUS CORRECTIONS AND AMENDMENTS, AS AN AMENDMENT TO THE BOULDER REVISED CODE, 1981.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council approved item 3B as part of the consent agenda motion.

agenda_items.title: CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO ACCEPT: 1. PROPOSED VISION AND GOALS FOR THE BOULDER RESERVOIR MASTER PLAN, AND 2. STUDY SESSION SUMMARY FROM DECEMBER 8, 2009
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council approved item 3C as amended to replace the first goal with alternate option 1 and the four bullets.

agenda_items.title: PUBLIC HEARINGS
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council adopted Ordinance No. 7709 designating the building and site at 1017 Maxwell Avenue as an individual landmark, unanimously, 9:0.

agenda_items.title: SECOND READING AND CONSIDERATION OF ORDINANCE No. 7709 DESIGNATING THE BUILDING AND SITE AT 1017 MAXWELL AVENUE, TO BE KNOWN ALSO AS THE INGLIS HOUSE, AS AN INDIVIDUAL LANDMARK UNDER THE CITY’S HISTORIC PRESERVATION CODE. THE HEARING ON THIS ITEM WILL BE HELD UNDER THE QUASI-JUDICIAL HEARING PROCEDURES OF THE B.R.C. OWNER/APPLICANT: CINDY AND LARRY MORPHEW.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council adopted Ordinance No. 7709 designating the building and site at 1017 Maxwell Avenue as an individual landmark, unanimously, 9:0.

agenda_items.title: MATTERS FROM THE CITY MANAGER
agenda_items.outcome_summary: City Manager Brautigam indicated staff would come back to council after the community process was concluded.

agenda_items.title: CITY MANAGER’S UPDATE ON IMPLEMENTATION OF PRIORITY BASED BUDGETING
agenda_items.outcome_summary: City Manager Brautigam indicated staff would come back to council after the community process was concluded.

agenda_items.section: MATTERS FROM MAYOR AND MEMBERS OF COUNCIL
agenda_items.title: MATTERS FROM MAYOR AND MEMBERS OF COUNCIL
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council discussed committee appointments and received updates on the US 36 Tiger Grant and Jefferson Parkway.

agenda_items.section: MATTERS FROM MAYOR AND MEMBERS OF COUNCIL
agenda_items.title: ANNUAL COUNCIL COMMITTEE APPOINTMENTS DISCUSSION.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council discussed committee liaison responsibilities and representatives, with additional discussion at the Council Retreat requested to determine representatives for some committees.

agenda_items.section: MATTERS FROM MAYOR AND MEMBERS OF COUNCIL
agenda_items.title: US 36 TIGER GRANT UPDATE. MAYOR OSBORNE
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Mayor Osborne reported no new news about the Tiger Grant, but potentially by the end of January.

agenda_items.section: MATTERS FROM MAYOR AND MEMBERS OF COUNCIL
agenda_items.title: JEFFERSON PARKWAY UPDATE. COUNCIL MEMBER COWLES
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council Member Cowles reported that a Denver Regional Council of Governments vote seemed to be moving toward parkway proponents and that he intended to participate in a late meeting Wednesday evening at DRCOG.

agenda_items.title: ADJOURNMENT
agenda_items.outcome_summary: There being no further business to come before Council at this time, BY MOTION REGULARLY ADOPTED, THE MEETING WAS ADJOURNED AT 9:55 P.M.
